The '''Feswe Minor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
Feswe Minor was a lifeless system on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|route]] between the [[Feswe Corridor]] and [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Feriae Junction]], a stopping point for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] ships running the [[Yavin blockade|Blockade of Yavin]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] cut off this route during the Rebels' attempt to evacuate [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="TEA" />
